body:
This does not fix the issue (as I understand it).

I don't really understand what you mean with the auto insertion part, but when I use this script:
```
func test() -> void:
	var b: Node
	b.
```
Place my cursor behind the dot (in vscode) and request code completion. The documentation for the listed members does not load. It does not work for constants either, and your PR does not change those documentations not loading.

Please retest the solution or give some better steps to reproduce the issue you are trying to solve! Also the following is important for verifying the solution: The script must not be edited after starting the Godot editor. So it must be in this invalid state from the start, otherwise you might run into a different bug with LSP document caching which is described in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105236.

I will also say, that the code of this fix does look sketchy to me. A proper solution would add a fallback for when no matching prefix is found instead of trying to produce an empty string to short circuit the `begins_with` check (that's what you are trying to do, right?).
